human_steering: 특정 이미지에 대한 보정만 하면 안되고, 어떤 이미지를 생성하더라도 하이엔드급의 결과물을 받아볼 수 있도록 스킬을 개선하는게 주 목적이야
primary_deliverable: Reusable runtime skill instructions and supporting design judgments, empirically improved across varied inputs.
current_twenty: Preserve the frozen H corpus and all20 requested roles. Individual self-repairs test the skill's ordinary workflow; they are evidence, not the primary product. Finish all20 selections before any critic feedback.
after_current_twenty: Aggregate repeated visual failures and successful controls across cases, identify decision-level causes, make material general instruction changes with explicit evidence. Do not ship case-specific copy, layouts, palettes or one-image prompts as the improvement.
transfer_validation: After changing the skill, freeze a new version and genuinely new requests unused in that revision. Current H transfer findings may become development evidence for the next version; never relabel them as that next version's heldout results.
limits: Keep each candidate/case/role's finite generation and review caps, failures and NA. Do not rename unchanged versions to reset budgets, replace low critics, or claim universal future quality from a finite pass set.
authorization: Prior user authorization for continued multi-agent simulation, skill improvement, commit and main merge persists. No confirmation needed for the authorized work.
